# 2010–2020: The Season of Two Homes

Retirement arrived not as a single event but as a gradual transition—the reduction of hours, the ceding of responsibilities, the slow disentanglement from the organizational identity that had defined professional life for four decades. Bob resisted the transition at first, as engineers often do; the idea of not working felt like a form of death, the cessation of the productivity that gave life meaning.
